question: Where and in what mutual arrangement should the fingers of the hands be placed?
premises: The fingers of the hands are to be arranged mutually.
They are to be fixed on that arrangement.
They are to be placed on the heart.
inference: One should place the mutually arranged fingers of the hands, fixed in that position, on the heart.
plain_english: One should place the fingers of the hands, mutually interlaced and fixed, upon the heart.
